summary.en: A check run on a copy: a dashed box (the source) links to an ink box (the copy); result rows fill, a counter climbs with an accent flash, and an accent band lands with two statements: what passed and what the person still decides.
summary.zh: 在副本上跑检查：虚线框（源）连到墨色框（副本）；结果行逐条填好，计数器上数并闪一下强调色，最后一条强调色带落下，写两句话：通过了什么、人还要决定什么。

fits: A proof page: a dry run, a replay on a shadow copy, a test pass before the person signs.
notFor: Results with more than six rows; failures to dramatise (the band states a pass).

intent.en: Prove the claim on a copy before anyone signs: rows of results and a counter, then a band that hands the last word to the person.
intent.zh: 在有人签字之前先在副本上证明：一行行结果和计数，最后用色带把决定权交还给人。

content.en: Page head, from and to box labels, 3–6 result rows (≤ 24 chars), a count, an optional blind-spot line, two statements (≤ 32 chars).
content.zh: 页头、源与副本框的标签、3–6 行结果（≤ 12 字）、一个计数、可选的盲区说明、两句陈述（≤ 14 字）。

fits.zh: 证据页：试运行、影子副本回放、人签字前的测试通过。

notFor.zh: 结果超过六行；要渲染失败的戏剧性（色带陈述的是通过）。

pairs.note: the loop that the proof feeds

en: The band's statements are on the accent: 34/40 px is the floor at about 3:1, keep them short.
zh: 色带上的文字在强调色上约 3:1，34/40 px 是下限，句子要短。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
